note: Animal voices (SND-003): cmd/sfxgen sends each prompt (+ defaults.suffix) to ElevenLabs text-to-sound-effects. Ids are animal.<roster key>.<call|attack|hurt|die>, the 9 voice groups animal.<group>.<event>, animal.generic.<event> and animal.burst. Our own words: describe the creature, never RimWorld names.
